title: GS21 leverage hump, continuous firm-level coupon, gs_bv -2.0, bounded exposure, per-firm level compensation (gs_qcomp 1)
question: gvylqc10 at a larger hump loading: does the room keep rising with the loading?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-04). With gs_qcomp 1 the room rises steeply in the loading: gvylqc3 0.2%, gvylqc5 1%, gvylqc10 10% (gap +0.019, 3/10 seeds at +0.029); gamma_v 4 did not help (gvylqc5g4 2%). gs_bv -2.0 continues the loading; otherwise gvylqc10.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-11-04): room 30% or more and a fair gap at or above +0.029. FALSIFIED if room is at or below 10% on three seeds.
